headline: It reads your whole kitchen, then plans the week's dinners.

slots.blurb: Save what you cook. It looks at all of it and sees what to make this week.

notes.title: What it reads
notes.text: Your saved recipes and their ingredients, what you cooked before, what you like and what you can't eat.

notes.title: What it plans
notes.text: Every Monday at 8 the app plans the week's dinners and writes one shopping list. Ask for ideas whenever you are stuck.

notes.title: Your account
notes.text: Sign in with your own account and pay by card. The weekly plan arrives by email.
